lessonTitle: 56. Dihedral angles. The angle between planes
lessonTitleEnglish: Dihedral angles. The angle between planes
unit: Geometry · Chapter II. Perpendicularity, distances and angles
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 10 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: A dihedral angle is formed by two half-planes with a common edge; its linear angle is formed by perpendiculars to the edge drawn in each face from one point.
stages.headlineEnglish: A dihedral angle is formed by two half-planes with a common edge; its linear angle is formed by perpendiculars to the edge drawn in each face from one point.

stages.headline: A dihedral angle is measured by its linear angle (0° to 180°); the angle between two planes is the smallest dihedral angle they form (0° to 90°).
stages.headlineEnglish: A dihedral angle is measured by its linear angle (0° to 180°); the angle between two planes is the smallest dihedral angle they form (0° to 90°).

stages.headline: Example: square side 4, SA ⊥ (ABC), SA = 4: the angle between (SBC) and (ABC) is ∠SBA = 45°.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: square side 4, SA ⊥ (ABC), SA = 4: the angle between (SBC) and (ABC) is ∠SBA = 45°.
